games.name: Become Forklift Certified Obby!
games.desc:
Join the Appalling Games group to unlock a FREE Ice Forklift skin!

Operate a forklift to complete the obby. Once you complete all 35 stages, you become forklift certified!
Go to the settings (gear icon) to toggle DPad controls.

Controls:
• WASD - Move your forklift
• Q - Lower fork
• E - Raise fork 
• Double Tap R - Reset character

Admin commands:
• /explode [player]
• /fling [player] [power (optional)]
• /give [player (optional)] [tool] - tools include btools, sword, and rocket/rocketlauncher
• /hint [message]
• /kick [player]
• /kill [player]
• /msg [message]
• /noclip [player (optional)] - Toggles noclip
• /walk [player]
Private server owners and star creators get admin commands!

Premium players get to use the Premium forklift skin!
Note: Real forklifts have turning wheels on the back, but it would've made turning much harder in this game.

Use codes: MiniUpdateRelease!, 3MIL!, SRRYFORDELAY! FOR INGAME REWARDS

The year is 2008. The sun is pale as always, the rents due, weapons are cheap, but most of all; today's garbage day, and you've got a lot of trash to take out.

Project Nevada Remastered is an open-ended game set in the Madness Combat universe about doing whatever you want, and how you please. Go around doing contracts for cash, be a general nuisance for nothing but kicks, be a janitor if you so desire. Become a respected SNPD officer you've always wanted to become or be the vigilante protagonist your ego always told you that you were.

-CTRL = Run
-F = Block
-R = Heavy attack
-Q = Dash

 
Make sure to join our communication server in order to not miss out on potential updates and keep track of Project Nevada's news!
